model_annotation: The plot illustrates how the metric labeled “Loss” changes over training iterations for six configurations listed in the legend (Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)). The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels at 20,000-iteration intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels spaced by 0.1. Each configuration is drawn as a solid line with a semi-transparent band around it: Vanilla is a purple line that drops steeply from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to roughly 2.7 by around 10,000 iterations, then decreases more gradually to about 2.46–2.48 by 140,000; StrmLLM (n=64) is a light/medium blue line that starts near 3.4, declines to about 2.85–2.90 by ~20,000, and then trends downward to roughly 2.61 by 140,000; SepLLM (n=64) is an orange line that begins near 3.4, falls to about 2.75 by ~10,000–20,000, and gradually declines to around 2.52 by 140,000; SepLLM (n=64, H) is a green line that starts near 3.4, decreases to around 2.74–2.76 by ~10,000–20,000, and continues down to about 2.50–2.51 by 140,000; SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is a red line that drops from near 3.4 to roughly 2.70–2.73 by ~10,000–20,000 and then decreases to around 2.49–2.50 by 140,000; SepLLM (n=128) is a darker blue line that follows a similar steep-then-gradual decline, starting near 3.4 and ending close to about 2.50 by 140,000.
